summary: Phase 3 Rework audit at cddadba3. HEAD equals the audited SHA. The diff b78fdde1..cddadba3 touches 11 files, all phase-owned: the mill fix, both mill shots, check-rework.sh, red-p3.log, green-p3.log, rework-mill.json, rerate-mill.json, rerate-mill.log, the plan.md Phase 3 lines, and the mill inventory row. The mill fix is the smallest change: scenes/maps/mill.ts:125 adds yaw: -65 to the watermill place and nothing else. git diff --exit-code over assets/watermill.ts, scripts/design-mill.mjs, docs/fantasy-world-scene-blueprints.tsv, and docs/map-review.html is empty. No source is duplicated. The inventory mill row appends Rework: 7619c491, Rerate: 7.5, and state accepted as the last cell; the MAPS, Judge, and maker cells stay byte-identical; the other 29 rows change nothing. The gate rerun passes: check-rework.sh exits 0 with 39 checks (PASS=39, FAIL=0), matching plan.md:110-118 word for word. check-review.sh exits 1 with 34 checks (PASS=33, FAIL=1): P2-d rejects the mill accepted state by design, exactly as plan.md:114-118 records. A git fixture under /tmp/opencode/p3fix-a (deleted after the run) proves the checker rejects every wrong record named in the brief: a reused shot (recency FAIL on both shots), a shot whose sha256 differs, a 3q elevation of 60, an Anthropic Sonnet judge, a hy judge, a second rerate file (P3-d counts five ratings), a 6.9 rerate marked accepted, and an inventory Rerate cell that disagrees with the record. Removing the mill Judge rating cell keeps mill in the below-bar set (conservative parse), so no vacuous pass exists. The rerate is independent: route kimi-code-plan-cn/kimi-for-coding differs from the original maker Anthropic Sonnet and the rework maker hy; rating 7.5, critical false; audited head 304a75d6 is an ancestor of HEAD; rerate-mill.log cites the route, the model id, and the rating. The stop rule holds: mill carries three labeled ratings (MAPS 7.0, Judge 5.5, Rerate 7.5), no fourth rating, no follow-up. Four nonblocking Nits remain: the plan evidence calls the mill ls command 'The plan gate' while the Gate block still names bathhouse paths; scripts/design-mill.mjs:25 would drop the yaw on a future generator run and no disposition records it; test-strategy.md:154 says mtime while the checker uses git recency; and Phase 4 should add one line so a closeout rerun of check-review.sh does not read the permanent red as a regression.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-a-p3 plan gate wording (measure/tracks/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/plan.md:112-113 versus plan.md:99-101): the Green evidence says 'The plan gate ls -l docs/map-mockups/mill-3q.png docs/map-mockups/mill-top.png lists both fresh shots', but the plan Gate block literally names bathhouse-3q.png and bathhouse-top.png, and bathhouse was never reworked (it rated 8.0 in Phase 2). The substance is true and verified live: both mill shots exist (1185352 and 1288124 bytes) and their last commit is 7619c491. The Gate block is strategy template residue; Phase 4 or the closeout should point the gate at the reworked slug.

F2 [Nit] review-a-p3 generator drift (scripts/design-mill.mjs:25): the generator still writes put('watermill', 2.2, -3.4) with no yaw, so a future generator run silently drops the rework and regenerates the edge-on wheel. green-p3.log:73-74 flags this handoff item, but plan.md carries no disposition. This was a manual mill.ts edit, which the plan allows, so no rule broke. Phase 4, the closeout, or measure/tech-debt.md should record it, or the generator should gain the yaw.

F3 [Nit] review-a-p3 freshness wording drift (measure/tracks/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/test-strategy.md:154 versus measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-rework.sh:19-21): the strategy says each shot has 'an mtime newer than the rework', while the checker proves recency with git log because a checkout resets mtime. The checker documents the reason and the falsifier still holds (fixture M1: a shot committed before the rework commit fails 'predates the rework commit'). A strategy wording fix would remove the drift; same class as the open F8 spec item.

F4 [Nit] review-a-p3 Phase 4 note for the by-design check-review.sh failure (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-review.sh, plan.md:114-118): check-review.sh now exits 1 permanently (PASS=33, FAIL=1; P2-d wants the Phase 2 rated state, mill holds accepted). Plan.md:114-118 records this by design, so Phase 3 itself needs no fix. Phase 4 does need one line: when records close, a rerun of every phase checker will show check-review.sh red forever; without a Phase 4 note, a reviewer can misread it as a regression.

Kimi differs from the original maker family Anthropic Sonnet and the rework maker family hy (rework-mill.json maker_route opencode-go/hy4-flash-free#high). rerate-mill.log cites the route, model_id kimi-for-coding, and Rating: 7.5 / 10. Stop rule: ls measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/rework-*.json rerate*.json shows exactly rework-mill.json and rerate-mill.json; no rerate-mill-* extra exists; mill holds three labeled ratings (MAPS rating 7.0, Judge rating 5.5, Rerate 7.5) and no fourth rating; no map enters follow-up.

Adversarial fixture (git repo under /tmp/opencode/p3fix-a, checker copy unmodified, deleted after the run; the permission layer denies shell cp and recursive rm, so a Node script built and removed it): CONTROL with faithful copies passes 39/39 exit 0. M1 record citing a commit newer than the shot commits: FAIL 'P3-b mill 3q shot commit ... predates the rework commit' and the same for top (a reused old shot cannot pass). M1b recorded sha with one hex digit changed: FAIL 'shot sha256 ... differs from the recorded'. M2 3q elevation 60: FAIL 'lies outside [45, 50]'. M3a judge model_family Anthropic Sonnet on route anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5: 4 FAILs including 'is in the original-maker/claude family' and 'equals the original maker family'. M3b judge model_family hy: FAIL 'equals the rework maker family [hy]'. M4 a second file rerate-mill-2.json: 5 FAILs including 'P3-d mill holds 5 ratings ... at most three' and 'holds 2 rerate files; the plan allows one rerate'. M5 rerate 6.9 with inventory Rerate 6.9 and state accepted: FAIL 'wants state [follow-up], found [accepted]' and FAIL 'holds accepted with a rating below 7.0'. M5b inventory Rerate 7.5 against record 6.9: FAIL 'inventory Rerate [7.5] differs from the rerate record [6.9]'. M6 mill Judge rating cell removed: 'Below-bar maps: mill' still holds (the empty parse fails toward more rework), so the A4 vacuous-pass falsifier holds.

The Red state failed for the expected reason: below-bar set {mill}, no rework record.

Green evidence verified: green-p3.log stage 1 records the Red re-run (PASS=21, FAIL=5), the shot commands (3q el=47 dist=34, top el=86 dist=34, agreeing with rework-mill.json cameras), both shot sha256 values, and the stage-1 handoff items; stage 2 records the same gate outputs the live rerun reproduces (39/39, 33/1, both shot sizes).
